Definition: from G1223 and G3736; to penetrate burglariously:--break through (up).
BiblicalUsage: To break through, the thief's word, digging through a wall to steal what is inside. Jesus warns that thieves break through and steal treasure laid up on earth, and tells us to watch because we do not know when the thief comes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe earthly treasure is never safe, and that is why Jesus tells me to lay it up where no thief breaks through. What I store in heaven is the only wealth no one can dig out.
